# account service homepage

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:accountServiceHomepage`](gmeow-accountServiceHomepage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/accountServiceHomepage>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/accounts`](../../slices/accounts.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The homepage of the service an account is held with — the [foaf:accountServiceHomepage](http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/accountServiceHomepage) of FOAF's [`OnlineAccount`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineAccount.md) idiom. Range open (an IRI).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:OnlineAccount`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineAccount.md) -> `?`; functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:accountServiceHomepage`](gmeow-accountServiceHomepage.md) from [`gmeow:OnlineAccount`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineAccount.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the homepage of the service an account is held with — the FOAF [`accountServiceHomepage`](gmeow-accountServiceHomepage.md) idiom — when exporting to FOAF or when the service is not modelled as a full [`gmeow:OnlineService`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineService.md) object.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the service is already a [`gmeow:OnlineService`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineService.md) (link with [`gmeow:accountService`](gmeow-accountService.md) and carry the homepage there) and for the account's own profile URL; this is the service homepage, not the account page.

### How to use

- Point the [`OnlineAccount`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineAccount.md) at the service homepage IRI; prefer [`gmeow:accountService`](gmeow-accountService.md) to a full [`OnlineService`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineService.md) when liveness or shutdown history matters, reserving this flat link for lightweight FOAF round-trips.
